read.md.description: Tool read: read a text file as plain lines, in parts if it is big.

ls.md.description: Tool ls: list one folder, one line per item; long and json for details.

view.md.description: Tool view: look into a file step by step: JSON level by level, big text as an outline first.

stat.md.description: Tool stat: facts about one file, folder or link as JSON (type, size, lines, format).

grep.md.description: Tool grep: search inside files with a regular expression, like grep -rn; one line PATH:LINE:TEXT per match.

glob.md.description: Tool glob: find files by name pattern (*, **, ?) under a folder; one path per line.

write.md.description: Tool write: write a whole file (new, or fully replaced).

edit.md.description: Tool edit: change part of a text file by exact text replacement.

copy.md.description: Tool copy: copy a file or a whole folder to a new path.

move.md.description: Tool move: move or rename a file, folder or link; also brings things back from the trash.

mkdir.md.description: Tool mkdir: create a folder with its parents; an existing folder is fine.

json_get.md.description: Tool json_get: the value at one FILE#/POINTER as one line of JSON; [too big] when over max_bytes.

json_ls.md.description: Tool json_ls: what is inside one place of a JSON file, one key or index per line; long for type and size.

json_search.md.description: Tool json_search: find a key and/or value below a place (or in the levels above it); one FILE#/POINTER per hit.

json_set.md.description: Tool json_set: set one place in a JSON file to a value, exactly as given; /- appends.

json_add.md.description: Tool json_add: add a new key or array item (inserts); never overwrites (KeyExists).

json_del.md.description: Tool json_del: delete one key or array item from a JSON file.

json_len.md.description: Tool json_len: the length of one place: keys of an object, items of an array, characters of a string.

json_multi_get.md.description: Tool json_multi_get: several FILE#/POINTER at once, one line per place; failures per place, PlacesFailed at the end.

json_multi_set.md.description: Tool json_multi_set: set several places in order, one line per place; nothing undone if one fails.

index_view.md.description: Tool index_view: see a node through its index (KEY<TAB>description); a view, not the facts.

jsonx_get.md.description: Tool jsonx_get: json_get for aos configuration files: follow $ref, resolve $ref/$env.

jsonx_ls.md.description: Tool jsonx_ls: json_ls for aos configuration files: follow $ref, list the resolved value.

jsonx_search.md.description: Tool jsonx_search: json_search for aos configuration files: follow $ref, search the resolved value.

jsonx_set.md.description: Tool jsonx_set: json_set for aos configuration files: value, text or from; follow, resolve, check.

jsonx_add.md.description: Tool jsonx_add: json_add for aos configuration files, with the options of jsonx_set.

jsonx_del.md.description: Tool jsonx_del: json_del for aos configuration files: $ref on the way protected unless follow.

jsonx_multi_get.md.description: Tool jsonx_multi_get: json_multi_get read like jsonx_get (follow, resolve for every place).

jsonx_multi_set.md.description: Tool jsonx_multi_set: json_multi_set done like jsonx_set: value, text or from per item; follow, resolve, check for all.

trash.md.description: Tool trash: delete so it can be undone (moved into .trash/ in your workspace).

remove.md.description: Tool remove: delete for real, like rm; no undo (a folder needs recursive).

shell.md.description: Tool shell: run one bash command line in your workspace; output ends with [exit code N].

run_python.md.description: Tool run_python: run a short Python 3 program; output ends with [exit code N].

peek_clock.md.description: Tool peek_clock: the daemon clock's current cycle and how many ms one cycle is.

peek_now_time.md.description: Tool peek_now_time: the current time, in UTC by default, or local time with {"local": true}.

math.md.description: Tool math: compute one arithmetic expression; what is allowed, examples, ExprBad.

todo.md.description: Tool todo: your own to-do list for a long task (ls, set, add, mark); kept outside your history.

goal.md.description: Tool goal: your goal, reminded when you stop by yourself; set, done, pause, resume.

../mailbox.md#/Mailbox tools.description: Pointer. Tools mailbox_peek, mailbox_read, mailbox_send: see which letters wait, read the oldest, send one. Explained in `aos/mailbox.md#/Mailbox tools`.

../user_zone.md#/How to send.description: Pointer. Tool user_send: send a decide/verify/trial/chore/fyi letter to the user zone. Explained in `aos/user_zone.md#/How to send`.

../user_zone.md#/The answer.description: Pointer. Tool user_verify: check that an answer letter really came from the user zone. Explained in `aos/user_zone.md#/The answer`.

../clock.md#/Wake me every N cycles.description: Pointer. Tool clock_register: letters from the clock every N cycles (add, rm, ls); once, at a time or cron: `aos/clock.md#/Wake me once, at a time, or on a schedule`. Explained in `aos/clock.md#/Wake me every N cycles`.

../me/self_hook.md#/Hooks: run a program.description: Pointer. Tool self_hook: run a program of yours when something happens to you (your own hooks, on_clock timers). Explained in aos/me/self_hook.md.

../me/do_task.md#/do_task: one task insi.description: Pointer. Tool do_task (agent-fsm only): do one task inside your own conversation and keep only its summary. Explained in aos/me/do_task.md.

../me/self_tools.md#/Changing your own t.description: Pointer. Tool self_tools: change your own tool list. Explained in aos/me/self_tools.md.

../me/self_llm.md.description: Pointer. Tool self_llm: change your own brain settings. Explained in aos/me/self_llm.md (the whole file is one text).

../me/self_system.md.description: Pointer. Tool self_system: see or change your own system text. Explained in aos/me/self_system.md (the whole file is one text).

../me/self_history.md#/Changing your own.description: Pointer. Tool self_history: list, delete, summarize or replace messages in your own conversation. Explained in aos/me/self_history.md.

../me.md#/Looking at yourself: self_stat.description: Pointer. Tool self_state: facts and numbers about yourself; it only reads. Explained in `aos/me.md#/Looking at yourself: self_state`.

../me.md#/Stopping yourself: self_ctl.description: Pointer. Tool self_ctl: stop, pause, put to sleep or remove yourself. Explained in `aos/me.md#/Stopping yourself: self_ctl`.

../agents/subagent.md#/Your own subagent.description: Pointer. Tool subagent: start and manage agents that are yours (counted against your quota). Explained in aos/agents/subagent.md.

../agents.md#/Any agent on the table: ag.description: Pointer. Tool agents_ctl: aos-agent ctl for any agent on your daemon table, not only yours. Explained in `aos/agents.md#/Any agent on the table: agents_ctl`.

../agents/fork.md#/fork: a copy of you,.description: Pointer. Tool fork (agent-fsm only): a copy of yourself for one goal; only its short conclusion comes back. Explained in aos/agents/fork.md.

../agents.md#/New definitions: agent_def.description: Pointer. Tool agent_def: make a new agent definition from a template, or check one. Explained in `aos/agents.md#/New definitions: agent_def`.

../tools_def.md#/tools_def.description: Pointer. Tool tools_def: make a new tool from the Python skeleton, or check a tool. Explained in aos/tools_def.md#/tools_def.

../kernel.md#/Being a kernel yourself: k.description: Pointer. Tool kernel_gate: be a kernel gate: requests from other procs are held, you pass or refuse each one. Explained in `aos/kernel.md#/Being a kernel yourself: kernel_gate`.

../cli/mcp_import.md#/Codes from externa.description: Pointer. mcp_tool: the program that runs every imported external MCP tool (you never call it by name); its error codes. Explained in `aos/cli/mcp_import.md#/Codes from external MCP tools`.

_description.md.description: One node per stock tool that has a page here: what it does, when to use it, its arguments, examples with real output and errors; how to read the pointer rows (keys starting with ../); packs are in aos/packs.md.
